versions.backend: TboxRclone working-tree WebDAV guard; isolated live service

cases.observation: Real Finder dragged a deterministic 1 MiB file to a fresh isolated target, showed copy progress, and completed. Computer Use opened Finder Quick Look, which displayed large.bin as 1 MB. A fixed ETag was then used with If-Match for first, middle, and last 4096-byte reads; all returned 206, exact Content-Range and the bytes from the complete expected object. The full WebDAV read and an independent direct-cloud full read both matched the source SHA-256.
